title: {item:bone_dice}
text:
翻出一副{item:bone_dice}。它不能打，但它是{b}祭品{/b}：骨头是{b}兽材{/b}，兽材是{faith:brute}最爱的，献祭时信力按稀有度再乘 {faith_offer:brute:beast_part:multiplier} 倍。

再搜一次。

texts.en:
You dig up some {item:bone_dice}. You can't fight with them, but they're an {b}Offering{/b}: bone is a {b}Beast Part{/b}, and {faith:brute} loves those. Offer them and the Faith, already set by Rarity, is multiplied by {faith_offer:brute:beast_part:multiplier}.

Search again.
